callback.verifierMissing: PKCE verifier missing (sessionStorage was lost; a new tab may have been opened or storage cleared)
callback.stateMismatch: State mismatch (CSRF guard; the login may have been hijacked)
callback.backToLogin: Back to home and log in again

login.cognitoNotConfigured: Cognito is not configured. Set COGNITO_DOMAIN and COGNITO_CLIENT_ID in the backend .env, then restart and try again.
login.tagline: An ML infrastructure platform built on SageMaker HyperPod, delivering everything from dev instances and distributed training to inference deployment in one place.

features.devInstance: Launch GPU dev instances in seconds, compatible with JupyterLab / VSCode / SSH
features.training: Distributed training + automatic NCCL injection + automatic checkpoint resume
features.inference: vLLM / SGLang / TRT-LLM inference frameworks, one-click launch + automatic scaling

login.subtitle: Log in to HyperPod Platform with your corporate account
login.securityNote: Login is protected by OIDC + PKCE, and the session is held in an HttpOnly cookie.

gate.configEndpointMissing: The backend endpoint /api/v1/auth/config is not implemented. Starting the PKCE flow requires the backend to expose this endpoint first.
gate.cognitoNotConfiguredDesc: The backend has no COGNITO_DOMAIN / COGNITO_CLIENT_ID configured. Local login requires the Cognito environment variables to be set first.
